Also need import for InputFormat maybe for tests that call schema.walk with InputFormat? That method signature: walk(ExecutionContext, String, InputFormat, boolean, ExecutionContextCustomizer). So they need InputFormat import. Also need ExecutionContextCustomizer import.

Also need to adjust calls to schema.walk that use Consumer<ExecutionContext> overload; there is method walk(ExecutionContext, JsonNode, boolean, Consumer<ExecutionContext>) returning ValidationResult. That's fine.

So compilation error earlier due to missing import of ValidationResult. So add import.

Also need import for ValidationMessage maybe not needed.

Now duplicate variable factory issue: rename or remove second declaration.

Also in setupBeforeEach they create schema = factory.getSchema(SIMPLE_SCHEMA); then later override with dummy. We can simplify: just set schema to dummy.

Now remove duplicate assignments.

Also afterEach duplicate null assignments not needed but fine.

Now adjust test walkNullInputFormat: they call schema.walk(executionContext, """...""", null, true, ctx -> {}); The method signature expects InputFormat not null? It will compile as null is acceptable for InputFormat param type. Need import InputFormat.

Now fix imports.

Also need to remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) annotation and its import.
